entries.title: rsync recipe: minimize SSH connections with controlpath
entries.statement:
Add to ~/.ssh/config: ```
Host *
    ControlMaster auto
    ControlPath ~/.ssh/cm-%r@%h:%p
    ControlPersist 10m
```. Now multiple rsync calls in a row reuse one TCP connection (avoiding SSH handshake each time). Critical for scripts that rsync many small things sequentially.
